description: Extensions left enabled when running manage-extensions.sh apply. Edit before apply; re-run snapshot after changes.
notes: apply disables every installed extension not listed in keepEnabled (optionalKeep is documentation only unless you copy ids into keepEnabled).
Re-enable one extension: cursor --enable-extension <id> then restart Cursor.
Re-enable everything from before apply: manage-extensions.sh restore
Heavy language servers (eslint, tailwind, go, terraform, docker, java pack): leave disabled globally; enable per workspace when you open that project.
